items.title: PNC bets on hospitality to counter AI disruption
items.why: Banks investing in human service as AI advice grows may raise expectations for premium card concierge experiences.
items.summary_ai: PNC is investing in hospitality training for staff, betting human service will gain value as AI-generated advice spreads.
items.take: Banks investing in human service as AI advice grows may raise expectations for premium card concierge experiences.
